title: REQ · ExecutionPanel shows a Reject button only for AWAITING_APPROVAL runs when onReject is given
summary: Reject button gated on status AWAITING_APPROVAL and presence of onReject, calling onReject with the id
description: Context: ExecutionPanelProps in ExecutionPanel.tsx has onApprove, onRetry and actionError only. Desired behavior: add optional onReject?: (id: string) => void and render a Reject button inside the execution-actions container when status is AWAITING_APPROVAL and onReject is defined. Expected result: clicking it calls onReject(id). Why: lets the admin reject a pending publication.
acceptance_criteria: Given AWAITING_APPROVAL with onReject, when rendered, then button Reject is present and clicking calls onReject with the execution id
Given no onReject, when rendered with AWAITING_APPROVAL, then Reject is absent
Given FAILED or RUNNING status, when rendered with onReject, then Reject is absent
Given AWAITING_APPROVAL, when Approve is clicked, then onApprove is called with the id and onReject is not
non_functional: Button is a native button with type=button for accessibility
